name: Milton Brewery (Dogfish Head) - Milton DE
type: Brewery / production facility (Dogfish Head main production; acquired by Boston Beer 2019)

fieldNotes.truckGate: No controlled truck gate. The brewery is set within the Cannery Village mixed-use development; trucks reach the operational yard directly from public development roads. Street View (2024) shows open road frontage with employee parking and no barrier arm or sliding gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth visible at any approach in Street View or satellite.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Confirmed by web research: 'The south side of the building receives the beer line and deliveries of bottles, labels, boxes, and kegs, while packaged products load into trucks along the north' — receiving and shipping run from physically separate building faces.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: ~12 dock doors estimated; the brewery integrates loading into the building and the NE/north operational yard. Exact count is hard from overhead because docks are partly recessed. Approximate, flagged.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Small NE operational yard handles trucks/tankers; no large marked trailer-drop lot. Few trailers seen — dropArea band 0-10, dropYard FALSE.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Operational yard on the NE side is open paved/gravel with room to maneuver; truck approach is not pinched against a busy public road.
fieldNotes.drivewayShort: Trucks come off development roads into a short approach to the dock/yard area; no deep multi-truck queue lane.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Primarily one large brewery building. A separate Dogfish Head shipping/distribution site exists at 25740 Cave Neck Rd, but that is a different facility off-site; this audit is of the production brewery only. multipleFacilities FALSE for this parcel.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property; site borders residential subdivisions and woods.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge of the small town of Milton DE, surrounded by residential subdivisions, woods and ponds -> Rural.
fieldNotes.trailersVisible: Only ~3 trailers/trucks visible in captured imagery; this brewery runs lighter on-site trailer staging than the larger network sites.
